actualOverBudget.title: Actual cost is over budget
actualOverBudget.why: Recorded actual cost already exceeds the active budget.
actualOverBudget.recommendation: Review postings and the budget before more spend is committed.

projectedOverBudget.title: Forecast cost is over budget
projectedOverBudget.why: Forecast final cost exceeds the active budget. Actual is still within budget.
projectedOverBudget.recommendation: Check remaining work and commitments before the overrun becomes actual.

insufficientBudget.title: Remaining budget may not cover what is left
insufficientBudget.why: Open commitments plus expected remaining cost exceed remaining budget.
insufficientBudget.recommendation: Revisit commitments, expected remaining cost, or the budget.

negativeForecastMargin.title: Forecast margin is negative
negativeForecastMargin.why: On current contract versus forecast cost, the project is projected to lose money.
negativeForecastMargin.recommendation: Review price, remaining cost, and unapproved commercial changes. This is not a posted loss.

marginDeterioration.title: Forecast margin is weaker than actual margin
marginDeterioration.why: Forecast margin is at least three points below actual margin.
marginDeterioration.recommendation: Look at remaining cost and commitments that are pulling margin down.

commitmentPressure.title: Open commitments are pressing remaining budget
commitmentPressure.why: Committed spend is large relative to budget still available after actual cost.
commitmentPressure.recommendation: Review open purchase orders before releasing more work.

billingLag.title: Billing is lagging cost
billingLag.why: A large share of contract cost is in before a matching share has been invoiced.
billingLag.recommendation: Check whether progress billing can be issued. Not a collection posting.

collectionRisk.title: A large share of invoices is still outstanding
collectionRisk.why: Outstanding collections are high relative to what has been invoiced.
collectionRisk.recommendation: Follow up on open billing. Outstanding is not a new cost.

consumptionVsProgress.title: Budget consumed is ahead of progress
consumptionVsProgress.why: The share of budget used is running well ahead of recorded physical progress.
consumptionVsProgress.recommendation: Check progress measurement and remaining work. Progress is not actual cost.

missingData.title: Not enough data for a confident forecast
missingData.why: Key inputs are incomplete, so this is a data gap — not a confirmed problem.
